lines.text: Did you know? Tain is Latin for hold.
Quick quiz! Which means back plus hold?

words.ex: This drink contains a lot of sugar.

The town has retained its traditional charm.

publish.title: Tain root: contain, obtain and retain
publish.value: Tain comes from Latin "tenere" (to hold). Words: contain, obtain and retain. contain = con + tain; obtain = ob + tain; retain = re + tain.
